coverage.scope: Default-profile Rust core, native C ABI, and host-compiled WASM facade, each reported once; all workspace packages remain in the report while only the unified_fixture_parity integration target executes; default coverage skips the duplicate ABI-only package preflight because make test-fast already executes that contract; the optional-feature contract is a separate make test-parity-smoke gate and is not rebuilt by coverage unless COVERAGE_PREPARE_OPTIONAL_FEATURES=1; unchanged generated oracle inputs preserved mtimes; optimized test profile opt-level=1 with no line-table debuginfo (COVERAGE_TEST_DEBUG=0) and COVERAGE_UNIFIED_WORKERS=1; one instrumented test binary runs in three independent shards per backend (nine shard processes total), each shard compares a disjoint 2,524- or 2,525-case slice and writes a distinct raw profile; isolated COVERAGE_ALL_TARGET_DIR with cargo llvm-cov --no-clean and stale .profraw cleanup before measurement; the report merges every shard profile; source-digest-bound expanded input cache reused across the nine processes; preloaded content digests reused for face-cache keys and read-only SFNT table-load/info routes; clean binary preparation uses cargo llvm-cov --no-report -- --list; build-state and independent preparation-state markers reuse unchanged compiler and oracle/API-audit inputs while excluding worker/lane-split/shard orchestration settings; raw LLVM JSON is ingested directly, with segment normalization retained only as an opt-in compatibility rewrite; test-harness source excluded
coverage.warning: LLVM JSON segments are normalized to segment start lines; aggregate region coverage is preserved from summaries.
